notes: Xiaovv (Macro-video Technologies Co., Ltd.) is a budget Xiaomi-ecosystem WiFi camera brand whose cameras are operated through the V380 app family (V380 / V380 Pro). Xiaovv publishes NO official fixed RTSP path: the official site (xiaovv.com) and FAQ (faq.xiaovv.com) document only app-based remote monitoring, with no RTSP or ONVIF URL specification. Every RTSP URL circulating for Xiaovv comes from third-party aggregators (iSpy/Agent DVR, camlytics) or from user reverse-engineering — notably the V380 /live/ch00_1 and /live/ch00_0 paths, which on many Xiaovv models are DISABLED by default and only become reachable via an unofficial workaround (a ceshi.ini test config from V380 technical support written to the SD card). ONVIF is likewise not officially advertised though some models respond to it. Per the CC0 no-guessing rule, no template is published. To integrate, use the V380 app, attempt ONVIF auto-discovery, or apply the community RTSP-unlock workaround at your own risk.
